design_philosophy: Prioritize clarity, simplicity, and speed of data entry for non-technical older Indian business owners. Zero 'SaaS fluff'. Mimic the straightforwardness of physical ledgers (Bahi Khata) using high-contrast digital elements, large typography, and strictly linear workflows.

numbers.notes: Use for all currency (₹), quantities, and tabular data to ensure vertical alignment of digits.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing for readability, tight spacing for data tables. p-6 or p-8 for form containers. gap-6 for form fields.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Keep metric cards simple: Big Number + Label.
layout_and_spacing.form_layout: Single-column layout for billing. Top-to-bottom flow. No multi-column zig-zagging which causes cognitive load.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Right-align all numbers and currency amounts in tables. Left-align text. Center headers only if necessary.

buttons.style: Large click targets (min-h-[48px]). Solid backgrounds for primary actions, distinct 1px borders for secondary. No subtle ghost buttons for critical actions.
buttons.text: Clear text labels over icons (e.g., 'Save Bill' instead of a floppy disk icon).

inputs.style: High contrast borders (border-gray-400, not gray-200). min-h-[48px] for easy clicking. Explicit, persistent labels ABOVE the field. No floating placeholders.

tables.style: Clear horizontal borders (border-b). Striped rows (even:bg-gray-50) to help older eyes track across long rows.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px solid border (#D4D4D8), minimal shadow (shadow-sm). Do not overuse glassmorphism or soft UI.

print_styles.invoice_layout: Strict A4 layout. Black and white only. Remove all interactive UI elements (buttons, navs) via @media print.
print_styles.invoice_typography: Sans-serif, 10pt-11pt for body, 14pt for headers. Bold for totals.
print_styles.invoice_grid: Item Name | HSN Code | Qty (mtr) | Rate (₹) | Taxable | GST (5%) | Total. Right-align all numerical columns.

animations.strategy: Minimalist. Zero parallax or staggered entrance animations. Immediate feedback only.
animations.interactions: Hover states (darken button bg), active states (scale down slightly), and instant toast notifications for success/error.

icons.usage: Use sparingly. Always pair with text labels for core actions. Size: 20px to 24px.

login_hero.description: Stacked folded cloths/fabrics representing wholesale textile inventory. Use on the login screen side-panel.

dashboard_placeholder.description: Thread spools, can be used as a subtle header background or empty state image.

testing_guidelines.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., 'login-submit-button', 'billing-customer-name-input', 'add-item-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Avoid any generic SaaS purples or teals.
Use Work Sans for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body/tables. Install these via Google Fonts if not present.
For the billing form, prioritize keyboard navigation. A user should be able to tab through 'Item -> HSN -> Qty -> Rate -> Add' without touching the mouse.
Do NOT use HTML native date inputs. Use Shadcn components but style them with high contrast.
Implement @media print CSS strictly for the invoice view. It must look like a standard Indian legal GST bill.
Keep metric cards on the dashboard simple: big bold numbers, clear labels. Avoid complex charts; use basic tables for 'Recent Sales' and 'Low Stock Alerts'.
Format all currency as INR (₹) using the Indian numbering system (e.g., 1,50,000 instead of 150,000).
Add data-testid attributes to ALL form inputs, buttons, and table rows for testing purposes.
